svg.title: Skill libraries and recorded transfers
svg.desc: Complete matrix of 42 skill names across seven donor libraries and twelve recipient directions. Checkmarks indicate retained code in every run. Four cells marked Some indicate code retained in some runs.
svg.text: 42 skill names · 7 donor libraries · 12 transfer directions
Donor = earlier task supplying the library. Recipient = new task receiving the code.
Skill absent from that donor library
